# DropSpace 1.0 — Stable release

<!-- update-summary: DropSpace 1.0 adds Island music and lyrics, file tools, device sharing, widgets, shortcuts and automatic updates since v0.2.1. -->

## Since v0.2.1

- Control music from the Island, follow synchronized lyrics and translate them on your device.
- Customize Island widgets and keyboard shortcuts.
- Preview files, create ZIP archives and convert or resize images.
- Share files with nearby devices and sync your clipboard between paired devices.
- Resume downloads, manage optional components and install app updates automatically in the installed edition.
- Choose from ten interface languages and set the lyric translation language separately.

## Installation notes

- The October 22 logo patch embeds the About image for installed and portable builds. Version remains 1.0.0; existing 1.0 installations need to rerun the updated Setup to receive this patch.

v0.3.2-beta.7 is the immediate upgrade baseline for this release. Existing settings, clipboard history, file references and downloaded optional components are retained. Windows Stable and Beta channels both receive 1.0 by numeric version order.

## Downloads and requirements

Windows 11 x64 or Windows Server 2022 x64 (build 20348 or later). Use `DropSpaceSetup.exe` for the installed app, `DropSpace.exe` for Portable, or the MSIX package for Windows-managed deployment. Portable updates use manual replacement. The independent CUDA component and optional model downloads retain their existing versions and hashes.

## Optional AI translation

AI translation remains experimental and off by default. Existing model quality and latency limitations remain; this host release does not claim new model validation. Original lyrics, provider translations, prompts, language admission and cache behavior are unchanged.
